description: Get one webhook delivery with its payload and every attempt, oldest first: HTTP status, duration, the first 2 KB of the response body and an error code (timeout, connection_error, tls_error, redirect_not_followed, unsafe_destination_url, non_2xx). Use this to find out why a delivery failed. Requires an Organization key.
